registration_statement: Written and committed in its own commit before any workspace build of abep_core and before any output comparison. At registration no workspace crate depends on abep_core, no case of cases_v1.json has been executed by any build, and no digest exists. The equalities, builds, case set, seeds, serialization and decision rule below are fixed; a change is a new addendum version (v2) and this record stays.
lane: B2 (ES-3 intake part of SC-WP-02), branch lane-es3-intake
purpose: Register what must be equal, and how it is checked, before workspace crates consume the admitted Kernel-1 TPMC library abep_core as a path dependency (rlib, without the `python` / `extension-module` features). abep_core stays a standalone crate outside the workspace (root Cargo.toml exclude) while parity_report_v2 binds its Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock / src sha256, and it is never modified.
governing_records: docs/decisions/OD_2026_10_05_A9_29_RUST_PLAN_V3_1_RULINGS_AND_START_AUTHORIZATION.md secs. 5 (RM-OQ-01: the Rust simulator calls the admitted Rust TPMC library directly; no DEFAULT_BACKEND flip), 7 (RM-OQ-03: TPMC keeps its admitted statistical contract), 11 (abep_core's Rust TPMC becomes a normal Rust library dependency)

docs/rust_migration/programme_v3_1.json cargo_workspace_proposal.abep_core / abep_core_a9_29 ('consumed as a path dependency after a registered build-equivalence addendum'), rules RM-R35, RM-R37, RM-R40

docs/rust_migration/CI_PLAN.md wave table row W0 ('build-equivalence step: K1-K5 on the registered vectors with the development seed, bitwise against the recorded extension, run as a contract addendum')

what_must_be_equal.EQ-01_sources: the six abep_core files listed in admitted_basis.recorded_build_provenance.source_sha256 are byte-identical to those sha256 values when every build below is made (checked before any build). A mismatch refuses the check (REFUSED_SOURCE_CHANGED); abep_core is read only and is never edited to make a build pass.
what_must_be_equal.EQ-02_toolchain: every build uses rustc 1.94.1 (e408947bf 2026-03-25) / cargo 1.94.1 (29ea6fb6a 2026-03-24), the parity_report_v2 toolchain pinned by rust-toolchain.toml. A different toolchain refuses the check (REFUSED_TOOLCHAIN).
what_must_be_equal.EQ-03_feature_set: the workspace consumes abep_core with default-features = false and no feature: in `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked` of the workspace, the resolved abep_core node has an empty feature list and no package named pyo3, numpy, pyo3-ffi or maturin is in the resolved graph. The `python` / `extension-module` features are never enabled by a workspace crate.
what_must_be_equal.EQ-04_outputs: for every case of cases_v1.json, the output bytes (serialization below) of each candidate build equal those of the reference build: same per-case sha256, hence bit-identical outputs.
what_must_be_equal.not_required_to_be_equal: object code. The workspace profiles differ from abep_core's own [profile.release] (lto = "fat", codegen-units = 1 apply only when abep_core is the root crate; as a dependency it is compiled with the root workspace's profile: dev = opt-level 0, release = opt-level 3 with Cargo's default lto / codegen-units). Equivalence is therefore shown on outputs, not assumed from the sources.

S0_standalone_gate.what: `cargo test --release --locked` with --manifest-path abep_core/Cargo.toml, run from the repository root (rust-toolchain.toml applies), CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside the source tree so nothing is written under abep_core/
S0_standalone_gate.requirement: every abep_core unit test passes (it is the standalone release build of the crate's own tests). abep_core cannot be given an output-dumping test without modifying it, so the standalone release OUTPUTS are taken from B0.

B0_reference_recorded_extension.what: the recorded extension itself (sha256 eb586f0386e793fadf4e7a2c4ce204679694b45c30b4627e77c84c9a175c8b6b, built by maturin from the six sources with abep_core's own [profile.release], i.e. the standalone release build that parity_report_v2 admitted), driven through its Python functions flux_weighted_entry / diffuse / cll / trace_channel / clausing_transmission with the case seeds and inputs
B0_reference_recorded_extension.availability_rule: the extension file actually loaded must have the recorded sha256; if it is absent or differs, the check is NOT_RUN_EXTENSION_UNAVAILABLE (no rebuilt or substitute binary is used as reference)

B1_workspace_release_standalone_profile.what: workspace path dependency (crates/abep-intake -> abep_core, rlib, default-features = false), `--release` with abep_core's own release settings applied to the build by command-line profile override: opt-level 3, lto "fat", codegen-units 1

B2_workspace_debug.what: workspace path dependency, the workspace dev profile (debug, opt-level 0)

B3_workspace_release.what: workspace path dependency, the workspace [profile.release] as committed (opt-level 3; Cargo defaults for lto and codegen-units)

case_set.source: the golden vectors and edge cases of the Kernel-1 comparison set (parity_prereg_v2.json comparison_set; the randomized domain is not used)

per_kernel.K1_entry: 9 golden (3 theta x 3 species, 200 km mean) + E1-01..E1-05; n = 2000 (prereg v2 n_per_replicate), one draw per case
per_kernel.K2_diffuse: 6 golden (3 species x normal sets plus_z / x_y_wall) + E2-01..E2-04; T_w 350 K unless the edge case sets it; n = 20000
per_kernel.K3_cll: 27 golden (3 species x 9 (alpha_n, alpha_t) pairs) + E3-01, E3-02; n = 20000; v_in = abep_core flux_weighted_entry(input_seed, n, V, 5 deg, T, m) at 200 km mean; normals = x_y_wall
per_kernel.K4_trace: 360 golden (4 L/d x 5 alpha x 3 theta x 3 species x 2 scattering, n = 8000) + E4-01..E4-17 (n = 4000); v0 = abep_core flux_weighted_entry(input_seed, n, V, theta, T, m); T_w 350 K, d 10 mm, max_hits 200, max_hits_cap 5000, unresolved_tol 1e-3 unless the edge case sets them; CLL alpha_n = alpha_t = alpha unless set
per_kernel.K5_clausing: 60 golden (4 L/d x 5 alpha x 3 species, Maxwell) + E5-01..E5-03; T_w 350 K; n = 20000

case_set.seeds: development_master_seed = 1 (parity_prereg_v2 campaign_seeds.development_master_seed; CI_PLAN W0: 'with the development seed'). seed = numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([1, j, k, 1])).integers(0, 2**64, dtype=uint64) (the prereg v2 Rust-seed derivation), input_seed the same with s = 2; j = kernel index K1=1..K5=5, k = case index within the kernel. Written explicitly into cases_v1.json. The scoring master seed 20261001 is not used.
case_set.inputs: every floating input is written into cases_v1.json as its shortest round-trip decimal, so all builds read identical bits: V and T from abep_sim.atmosphere.atmosphere(200.0, 'mean', use_msis=False); m from abep_sim.constants.M_SPECIES; R = 0.005 m; L = L/d x 0.01 m; theta in radians (math.radians). Normal sets are explicit vectors; normal i of a set is set[i mod len(set)]. K3 and K4 inputs drawn by abep_core itself (input_seed) differ from prereg v2's numpy-drawn shared inputs; equivalence needs identical inputs across builds, not the v2 inputs.
case_set.deviation_from_prereg_v2_inputs: documented above (input generation, one K1 draw per case, deterministic x_y_wall normals); none of it is a parity claim against the Python reference, which parity_report_v2 already settled

kernel_calls.K1_entry: v = flux_weighted_entry(seed, n, v_drift, theta, t, m)
kernel_calls.K3_cll: v_in = flux_weighted_entry(input_seed, n, v_drift, theta, t, m); v = cll(seed, v_in, normals(n), t_w, m, alpha_n, alpha_t)
kernel_calls.K4_trace: v0 = flux_weighted_entry(input_seed, n, v_drift, theta, t, m); (collected, v, hits, back, unresolved) = trace_channel(seed, v0, r, l, alpha, t_w, m, max_hits, scattering, alpha_n, alpha_t, unresolved_tol, max_hits_cap)
kernel_calls.K5_clausing: k = clausing_transmission(seed, r, l, alpha, t_w, m, n)
kernel_calls.seeding: each call starts a fresh abep_core Rng::new(seed), exactly as the extension's Python functions do

execution.serialization: per case, the bytes hashed (sha256) are the concatenation, in this order, of: K1 v; K2 v; K3 v_in then v; K4 v0, collected, v, hits, back, unresolved; K5 k. f64 = 8-byte little-endian IEEE-754 bit pattern (arrays row-major, (n, 3) as x, y, z per row); bool = one byte 0x00 / 0x01; i64 = 8-byte little-endian two's complement. Total digest = sha256 of the per-case lower-case hex digests joined by '\n' in case order.
execution.runner: one case-runner implementation for B1-B3 (in crates/abep-intake) and one Python driver for B0, both reading cases_v1.json; added after this registration

decision_rule.rule: EQUIVALENT iff S0 passes, EQ-01, EQ-02 and EQ-03 hold, and for every one of the 493 cases the per-case sha256 of B1, B2 and B3 each equals that of B0. Any differing case makes the verdict NOT_EQUIVALENT; every differing case is listed. No tolerance applies: equality is bitwise.
decision_rule.executions: the check is executed once for v1 and the result committed whatever the verdict (result_v1.json + .md next to this file); no execution is discarded
decision_rule.meaning_of_EQUIVALENT: workspace crates may consume abep_core as a path dependency (rlib, no python feature); within the tested profiles (dev, workspace release, release with abep_core's own settings) the workspace build reproduces the admitted Kernel-1 binary bit for bit, so the Kernel-1 ADMITTED status of parity_report_v2 carries over to this consumption. It admits nothing else (intake_response, response_surface, IntakeSurface and intake.py need their own contracts), it is not physics evidence, and it does not re-score the Python-vs-Rust statistical parity (A9.29 sec. 7: TPMC keeps its admitted statistical contract).
decision_rule.meaning_of_NOT_EQUIVALENT: no workspace crate may call abep_core until the cause is classified and a new addendum version passes; abep_core itself is not edited by this lane
decision_rule.regression_guard: after an EQUIVALENT verdict, the recorded B0 per-case digests become a cargo integration test of crates/abep-intake that replays the full case set under whichever profile the test runs in and requires bitwise equality (CLAUDE.md rule 9: no ignored test). It must also hold after any change of abep_core sources (which already needs a new parity report), the toolchain, Cargo.lock or a workspace profile.

what_this_is_not: not a new parity campaign against the Python reference (parity_report_v2 stands; this addendum only shows that a different build of the same sources gives the same bits)
not a change to abep_core, its Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock / sources, the recorded extension or parity_report_v2
not a change of the Python wrapper default (abep_sim/design/tpmc_backend.py DEFAULT_BACKEND stays 'python'; RM-OQ-01, no flip step)
not physics evidence, not a gate PASS
